sloka: राजन् त्वम् तेजसा तस्य स शरीरो दिवम् व्रज ।उक्त वाक्ये मुनौ तस्मिन् स शरीरो नर ईश्वरः ॥१-६०-१५॥
transliteration: rājan tvam tejasā tasya sa śarīro divam vraja ।ukta vākye munau tasmin sa śarīro nara īśvaraḥ ॥1-60-15॥

translations.english: "O Descendant of Kakustha (Rama) when the sage had said these words, the king with his physical body ascended to heaven in the presence of the sages.
